# archestra_plugin (Resource)

Manually managed plugin package with authoritative UTF-8/base64 file content and executable modes. Applying files stores opaque bytes without executing plugin hooks. Derived plugin skills remain owned by the package. Git-sourced plugin content is managed through its repository declaration rather than this manual-file resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "archestra_plugin" "example" {
  display_name        = "Operational helpers"
  client_type         = "claude-code"
  supported_platforms = ["posix"]
  enabled             = true
  files = {
    ".claude-plugin/plugin.json" = {
      content = jsonencode({ name = "operational-helpers", version = "1.0.0" })
    }
    "README.md" = {
      content = "Operational helper package."
    }
    "scripts/check.sh" = {
      content = "#!/bin/sh\nprintf 'ready\n'\n"
      mode    = "100755"
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `client_type` (String) Immutable target client format.
- `display_name` (String) Plugin display name.
- `files` (Attributes Map) Complete plugin file set keyed by safe relative path. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--files))
- `supported_platforms` (Set of String) Supported operating-system families.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Package description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the package is enabled; omission preserves the current setting.
- `icon` (String) Emoji or base64 image URL; omission clears the override.
- `initial_grants` (Attributes Set) Direct grants applied atomically when the object is created; changes require replacement, and later permission changes belong to archestra_resource_permission_policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--initial_grants))
- `labels` (Attributes Set) Credential labels; an empty set clears them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--labels))

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import archestra_plugin.example <uuid>
```
